tEn: Aya Model: An Instruction Finetuned Open-Access Multilingual Language Model
tZh: Aya模型：一种指令微调的开源多语言语言模型
sEn: Aya is an instruction-tuned multilingual model that supports 101 languages, outperforming existing models on most tasks while covering twice as many languages.
sZh: Aya是一个支持101种语言的指令微调多语言模型，在多数任务上优于现有模型，且覆盖语言数量翻倍。
absEn: Recent breakthroughs in large language models (LLMs) have centered around a handful of data-rich languages. What does it take to broaden access to breakthroughs beyond first-class citizen languages? Our work introduces Aya, a massively multilingual generative language model that follows instructions in 101 languages of which over 50% are considered as lower-resourced. Aya outperforms mT0 and BLOOMZ on the majority of tasks while covering double the number of languages. We introduce extensive new evaluation suites that broaden the state-of-art for multilingual eval across 99 languages -- including discriminative and generative tasks, human evaluation, and simulated win rates that cover both held-out tasks and in-distribution performance. Furthermore, we conduct detailed investigations on the optimal finetuning mixture composition, data pruning, as well as the toxicity, bias, and safety of our models. We open-source our instruction datasets and our model at https://hf.co/CohereForAI/aya-101
absZh: 近期大语言模型（LLMs）的突破主要集中在少数数据丰富的语言上。如何将突破扩展到这些一流语言之外？我们的工作引入了Aya，一个大规模多语言生成语言模型，能够执行101种语言的指令，其中超过50%被认为是低资源语言。Aya在大多数任务上优于mT0和BLOOMZ，同时覆盖的语言数量是其两倍。我们引入了广泛的新的评估套件，将多语言评估的最新水平扩展到99种语言——包括判别式和生成式任务、人工评估以及模拟胜率，这些评估既涵盖保持任务又涵盖分布内性能。此外，我们对最优微调混合物组成、数据剪枝以及模型的毒性、偏见和安全性进行了详细调查。我们在https://hf.co/CohereForAI/aya-101开源了我们的指令数据集和模型。

limits.zh: 训练数据仍偏向高资源语言，翻译数据可能传播系统性翻译错误。

paras.en: Abstract: Recent breakthroughs in large language models (LLMs) have centered around a handful of data-rich languages. What does it take to broaden access to breakthroughs beyond first-class citizen languages? Our work introduces Aya, a massively multilingual generative language model that follows instructions in 101 languages, of which over 50% are considered lower-resourced. We introduce extensive new evaluation suites that broaden the state of the art for multilingual evaluation across 99 languages—including discriminative and generative tasks, human evaluation, and simulated win rates that cover both held-out tasks and in-distribution performance. Furthermore, we conduct detailed investigations on the optimal fine-tuning mixture composition, data pruning, as well as the toxicity, bias, and safety of our models. We open-source our instruction datasets and our model at https://hf.co/CohereForAI/aya-101
paras.zh: 摘要：近年来，大语言模型（LLMs）的突破主要集中在少数几种数据丰富的语言上。要让这些突破惠及“一等公民”语言之外的语言，需要做些什么？我们的工作推出了 Aya——一个大规模多语言生成式语言模型，能够遵循 101 种语言的指令，其中超过 50% 被视为低资源语言。Aya 在大多数任务上优于 mT0 和 BLOOMZ，同时覆盖的语言数量是它们的两倍。我们引入了广泛的新评测套件，将多语言评测的最先进水平扩展到 99 种语言，涵盖判别式与生成式任务、人工评估，以及覆盖留出任务和分布内性能的模拟胜率。此外，我们还对最优微调数据混合组成、数据剪枝以及模型的毒性、偏见和安全性进行了详细研究。我们在 https://hf.co/CohereForAI/aya-101 开源了我们的指令数据集和模型。

paras.en: The limits of my language means the limits of my world. — Ludwig Wittgenstein
paras.zh: 我的语言的界限意味着我的世界的界限。——路德维希·维特根斯坦

paras.en: A fundamental question in machine learning is how to effectively capture the nuances of the long tail. The world around us, encompassing language and tangible objects, is naturally filled with rare and underrepresented examples. Yet, this imbalance intensifies as we transpose our intricate world into the matrices of data that train our models. Datasets have been the foundation of modern machine learning progress, but have coalesced around a few data-rich languages. What languages are favored is often a symptom of historical technological use and access to resources, rather than the languages most frequently spoken or written in the real world [Xue et al., 2020a; Bird, 2022]. ♦ First authors.
paras.zh: 机器学习的一个根本问题是如何有效捕捉长尾中的细微差别。我们周围的世界——包括语言和有形物体——天然充满了稀有且代表性不足的样本。然而，当我们把复杂的现实世界转置为训练模型的数据矩阵时，这种不均衡会进一步加剧。数据集是近代机器学习进步的基石，但目前它们集中于少数数据资源丰富的语言。哪些语言受到青睐，往往是历史技术使用和资源可及性的症状，而非现实世界中最常被说或写的语言 [Xue et al., 2020a; Bird, 2022]。♦ 第一作者。

paras.en: Recent breakthroughs in natural language processing (NLP) have been no different, with the instruction-following capabilities of existing open-source models, such as Alpaca [Taori et al., 2023a], Dolly [Conover et al., 2023b], and Vicuna [Chiang et al., 2023], mainly developed for English tasks. Instruction finetuning (IFT) involves curating pairs of prompts and completions, and has been shown to significantly improve the helpfulness and general instruction following capabilities of large language models (LLMs) [Anil et al., 2023; Sanh et al., 2022; 2021; Wei et al., 2021; Iyer et al., 2022; Muennighoff et al., 2023d; Chung et al., 2022; Zhang et al., 2023c; Wang et al., 2022c]. However, a sizable gap between the available amount of instruction prompts for English and all other languages exists. More than 7,000 languages¹ are spoken around the world today, but an astounding 73% of popular IFT datasets are primarily English [Longpre et al., 2023b].
paras.zh: 自然语言处理（NLP）近期的突破也不例外，现有开源模型的指令遵循能力，如 Alpaca [Taori et al., 2023a]、Dolly [Conover et al., 2023b] 和 Vicuna [Chiang et al., 2023]，主要针对英文任务开发。指令微调（IFT）涉及整理提示词和补全的配对，已被证明能显著提升大语言模型（LLM）的有用性和通用指令遵循能力 [Anil et al., 2023; Sanh et al., 2022; 2021; Wei et al., 2021; Iyer et al., 2022; Muennighoff et al., 2023d; Chung et al., 2022; Zhang et al., 2023c; Wang et al., 2022c]。然而，英文与其他所有语言在可用指令提示词数量之间存在巨大差距。当今全世界使用超过 7,000 种语言¹，但令人震惊的是，73% 的主流 IFT 数据集主要为英文 [Longpre et al., 2023b]。

paras.en: This severe sampling bias in the construction of our datasets violates a key machine learning principle: your training distribution should mirror the underlying distribution you hope to model in the real world. The consequence is that recent breakthroughs in NLP have amplified disparities in model performance outside of resource-rich languages. Models perform better on the distribution they are trained to mimic [Kunchukuttan et al., 2021], which often introduces known biases towards languages not included during training [Schwartz et al., 2022; Kotek et al., 2023; Khandelwal et al., 2023; Vashishtha et al., 2023; Khondaker et al., 2023] and critical security and safety flaws for all users [Yong et al., 2023a; Nasr et al., 2023; Li et al., 2023c; Lukas et al., 2023; Deng et al., 2023]. A growing divide in the cost of use of technology is emerging as marginalized languages require more tokens and incur higher latency for generations [Ji et al., 2023b; Cui et al., 2023; Ahia et al., 2023]. ¹ https://www.ethnologue.com/
paras.zh: 这种在数据集构建中的严重采样偏差违反了一条关键的机器学习原则：你的训练分布应当反映你希望在真实世界中建模的潜在分布。其后果是，近期的 NLP 突破放大了模型在资源丰富语言之外的表现差距。模型在它们被训练去模仿的分布上表现更好 [Kunchukuttan et al., 2021]，而这往往会对训练时未包含的语言引入已知偏差 [Schwartz et al., 2022; Kotek et al., 2023; Khandelwal et al., 2023; Vashishtha et al., 2023; Khondaker et al., 2023]，并对所有用户造成严重的安全与安保缺陷 [Yong et al., 2023a; Nasr et al., 2023; Li et al., 2023c; Lukas et al., 2023; Deng et al., 2023]。随着边缘化语言需要更多词元（token）且生成时产生更高延迟，技术使用成本之间的鸿沟正在扩大 [Ji et al., 2023b; Cui et al., 2023; Ahia et al., 2023]。¹ https://www.ethnologue.com/

paras.en: 2. Consigning speakers of lower-performing languages to lower-quality technology [Held et al., 2023; Durmus et al., 2023; Nicholas & Bhatia, 2023; Ojo et al., 2023].
paras.zh: 2. 使表现较差语言的用户只能使用较低质量的技术 [Held et al., 2023; Durmus et al., 2023; Nicholas & Bhatia, 2023; Ojo et al., 2023]。

paras.en: Bridging this widening language gap and conferring multilingual instruction-following capabilities is not a trivial problem. Some multilingual abilities can be inherited by pre-training on diverse multilingual data [Brown et al., 2020] — often described as surprising multilingual abilities noted in fine-tuned models like PaLM [Chowdhery et al., 2022] or Flan-PaLM [Chung et al., 2022] which are not explicitly fine-tuned to be multilingual [Briakou et al., 2023]. However, this was not proven to be competitive with a second direction of both pre-training and instruction fine-tuning with a multilingual corpus. Pursuing this second approach has been the subject of several recent works [Muennighoff et al., 2023d; Wei et al., 2023; Lai et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2023d; Shaham et al., 2024; Chen et al., 2024] where the persistent struggle to secure comprehensive multilingual IFT datasets remains a fundamental obstacle. This second direction is the focus of our work.
paras.zh: 弥合这一日益扩大的语言鸿沟，并赋予多语言指令跟随能力，并非易事。某些多语言能力可以通过在多语言数据上进行预训练而获得 [Brown et al., 2020]——这些能力通常被描述为在未明确针对多语言进行微调的模型（如 PaLM [Chowdhery et al., 2022] 或 Flan-PaLM [Chung et al., 2022]）中出现的令人惊讶的多语言能力 [Briakou et al., 2023]。然而，这种做法并未被证明能与第二种方向相竞争，即同时利用多语言语料库进行预训练和指令微调。近年来，这一第二种方向已成为几项研究的主题 [Muennighoff et al., 2023d; Wei et al., 2023; Lai et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2023d; Shaham et al., 2024; Chen et al., 2024]，其中，获取全面的多语言 IFT 数据集的持续困难仍是一个根本性障碍。第二种方向正是我们工作的重点。

paras.en: In this work, we address several core limitations of recent multilingual IFT models in order to reduce their linguistic inequality: We aim to create a model that performs well on downstream tasks when given prompts in any of the included languages, rather than requiring multilingual speakers to write prompts in English. Our goal is also to greatly expand the coverage of languages to 101, far beyond the current coverage of open-source massively multilingual models such as Okapi [Lai et al., 2023] (25 languages), mT0 [Muennighoff et al., 2023d] (46 languages), BLOOMZ [Muennighoff et al., 2023d] (46 languages), and Bactrian-X [Li et al., 2023b] (52 languages). To do so, we embark on an ambitious effort to expand the size of the training corpus as well as the breadth of evaluation.
paras.zh: 在本工作中，我们解决近期多语言 IFT 模型的几个核心局限，以减少其语言不平等性：我们的目标是创建这样一个模型，当给定任何所覆盖语言的提示时，它都能在下游任务上表现良好，而不是要求多语言用户用英语编写提示。我们还希望将语言覆盖范围大幅扩展到 101 种，远超现有开源大规模多语言模型的覆盖范围，例如 Okapi [Lai et al., 2023]（25 种语言）、mT0 [Muennighoff et al., 2023d]（46 种语言）、BLOOMZ [Muennighoff et al., 2023d]（46 种语言）和 Bactrian-X [Li et al., 2023b]（52 种语言）。为此，我们开展了一项雄心勃勃的工作，以扩大训练语料库的规模以及评估的广度。

paras.en: The core contribution of our work, highlighted in Figure 1, is an open-source multilingual instruction-fine-tuned LLM with diverse linguistic representation: the Aya model. Our primary contributions can be enumerated as follows:
paras.zh: 我们工作的核心贡献（如图 1 所示）是一个开源的多语言指令微调大语言模型（LLM），具有多样化的语言表示：Aya 模型。我们的主要贡献如下：

paras.en: **1. Expansion of Language Coverage** We significantly expand the size of available training data to directly address the linguistic inequality of recent NLP development. In comparison to recently proposed multilingual IFT datasets such as xP3 which covers 46 languages and includes 81M data points [Muennighoff et al., 2023d], our Aya training mix broadens coverage to 101 languages and is 2.5× the size of the original xP3 dataset with 203M data points. Perhaps more significantly, while prior datasets like xP3 remain 39% English, our mix is far less skewed with only 21.5% English. Among the 101 languages covered by Aya, 51 are deemed lower-resourced [Joshi et al., 2020].
paras.zh: **1. 语言覆盖范围的扩展** 我们大幅扩展了可用训练数据的规模，以直接应对近期自然语言处理（NLP）发展中的语言不平等问题。与近期提出的多语言 IFT 数据集（如覆盖 46 种语言、包含 8100 万数据点的 xP3 [Muennighoff et al., 2023d]）相比，我们的 Aya 训练混合数据将覆盖范围扩大到 101 种语言，且规模是原始 xP3 数据集的 2.5 倍，包含 2.03 亿个数据点。也许更重要的是，虽然 xP3 等先前数据集中英语仍占 39%，但我们的混合数据偏斜程度远低，英语仅占 21.5%。在 Aya 覆盖的 101 种语言中，有 51 种被认为是低资源语言 [Joshi et al., 2020]。

paras.en: 2. Broadening Multilingual Evaluation We extend the axes of multilingual evaluation to cover 99 languages by investing in evaluation across 1) discriminative, 2) generative, 3) LLM-as-a-judge simulated win rate comparisons, 4) human evaluation, and 5) safety evaluations. Across these benchmarks, our Aya model demonstrates relative performance gains of 13.1% and 11.7% over mT0x2 for discriminative and generative tasks respectively. Human preference evaluations for 7 languages show win rates of 75% relative to mT0x.
paras.zh: 2. 扩展多语言评估 我们通过投资于以下五个方面的评估，将多语言评估的维度扩展到覆盖99种语言：1) 判别式评估、2) 生成式评估、3) LLM-as-a-judge模拟胜率比较、4) 人类评估，以及5) 安全评估。在这些基准测试中，我们的Aya模型在判别式和生成式任务上相对于mT0x2分别展现了13.1%和11.7%的相对性能提升。针对7种语言的人类偏好评估显示，相对于mT0x的胜率为75%。

paras.en: 3. Data Weighting and Pruning Our emphasis on only using datasets with permissive licensing results in an over-indexing of academic-style multilingual datasets [Longpre et al., 2023b]. 2 mT0x is a variant of mT0 fine-tuned on 101 languages using xP3x. Details in §3.3
paras.zh: 3. 数据加权与剪枝 我们只使用具有宽松许可的数据集，这导致对学术风格的多语言数据集过度关注 [Longpre et al., 2023b]。2 mT0x 是使用xP3x在101种语言上微调的mT0变体。详见 §3.3。

paras.en: To rebalance the distribution, we explore the benefits of data pruning, removing 19.66% of English instances and 18.25% of multilingual instances based upon human annotations. Additionally, we conduct extensive ablations to explore the role of different data sources by varying the weight of 1) translated data, 2) templated data, and 3) human annotations.
paras.zh: 为了重新平衡数据分布，我们基于人工标注移除了19.66%的英文实例和18.25%的多语言实例，以此探索数据剪枝的好处。此外，我们通过改变1）翻译数据、2）模板数据、3）人工标注的权重，进行了广泛的消融实验，以探究不同数据来源的作用。

paras.en: 4. Safety: We implement multilingual safety context distillation as a first step towards mitigating LLM safety concerns multilingually (§6). This step reduces harmful generations for adversarial prompts by 78–89% as judged by human experts. To further characterize the risk profile of our model, we perform an analysis of toxicity, social bias, and gender bias in models’ generations across 18 languages (§7).
paras.zh: 4. 安全性：我们实现了多语言安全上下文蒸馏，作为在多语言环境中缓解LLM安全问题的第一步（§6）。根据人类专家的评估，这一步骤使对抗性提示的有害生成降低了78%–89%。为了进一步刻画我们模型的风险特征，我们对18种语言的模型生成内容进行了毒性、社会偏见和性别偏见分析（§7）。

paras.en: By releasing the Aya model, we hope to empower researchers and practitioners to advance multilingual models and applications. Aya model is available with a fully open-source Apache 2.0 License here: https://hf.co/CohereForAI/aya-101.
paras.zh: 通过发布Aya模型，我们希望赋能研究人员和从业者推进多语言模型与应用。Aya模型以完全开源的Apache 2.0许可证在此提供：https://hf.co/CohereForAI/aya-101。

paras.en: To date, multilingualism in LLM instruction fine-tuning (IFT) has been plagued by two challenges: 1) data scarcity with a lack of language coverage, and 2) the low quality of the existing data. For example, while both xP3 [Muennighoff et al., 2023d] and Flan [Longpre et al., 2023a] include multilingual data, the instructions are still written in English. Furthermore, these datasets are frequently generated using manually curated templates, which can result in low prompt and completion diversity [Muennighoff et al., 2023d], which is critical for model performance [Naik et al., 2023; Chung et al., 2023b; Li et al., 2023e; Lahoti et al., 2023].
paras.zh: 迄今为止，LLM 指令微调（IFT）中的多语言能力一直受到两个挑战的困扰：1）数据稀缺且语言覆盖不足；2）现有数据质量低下。例如，虽然 xP3 [Muennighoff et al., 2023d] 和 Flan [Longpre et al., 2023a] 都包含多语言数据，但其指令仍然是用英文编写的。此外，这些数据集经常使用手动策划的模板生成，这可能导致提示和补全多样性不足 [Muennighoff et al., 2023d]，而多样性对模型性能至关重要 [Naik et al., 2023; Chung et al., 2023b; Li et al., 2023e; Lahoti et al., 2023]。

paras.en: Given the lack of multilingual instruction data, we combine a range of approaches to improve the availability of data (under the Apache 2.0 License, see https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).
paras.zh: 鉴于多语言指令数据的缺乏，我们结合了一系列方法来提高数据的可用性（在 Apache 2.0 许可证下，参见 https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0）。

paras.en: This includes relying on extensive efforts to aggregate and prune multilingual templates and hard-to-find human annotations curated by fluent speakers of various languages. Moreover, it also extends to data augmentation strategies such as machine translation and leveraging synthetic data generation coupled with translation. Table 1 summarizes these data sources and their characteristics, such as the number of languages, total size, and instruction length. In the following sections, we describe each data source in detail.
paras.zh: 这包括依靠大量工作来聚合和精简多语言模板，以及由各种语言的流利使用者策划的难以获得的人工标注。此外，还扩展到了数据增强策略，如机器翻译和利用与翻译相结合的合成数据生成。表 1 总结了这些数据源及其特征，如语言数量、总规模和指令长度。在以下各节中，我们将详细介绍每个数据源。

paras.en: A focus on data provenance and permissive data. Following the findings of previous works [AlShikh et al., 2023; Zhou et al., 2023; Chen et al., 2023], we select our training data to increase (1) high-quality data; (2) prompt-type diversity including few-shot, chain-of-thought, and dialog-style prompts; and (3) task diversity. While there is an ever-growing number of datasets used to train LLMs that satisfy the above criteria, many of these have inconsistent documentation, which can cause legal and ethical issues for practitioners [Longpre et al., 2023b]. Given our goal of releasing Aya under a fully permissive, open-source approved⁴ Apache 2.0 License, we place emphasis on data provenance. To the best of our ability, we use license annotations from the Data Provenance Collection [Longpre et al., 2023b] to discern which public supervised datasets have been checked for self-reported commercially permissive licenses as well as satisfying our above criteria.
paras.zh: 关注数据来源和宽松许可数据。根据先前工作的发现 [AlShikh et al., 2023; Zhou et al., 2023; Chen et al., 2023]，我们选择训练数据以增加（1）高质量数据；（2）提示类型多样性，包括少样本、思维链和对话式提示；（3）任务多样性。虽然有越来越多的用于训练 LLM 的数据集满足上述标准，但其中许多数据集的文档不一致，这可能会给从业者带来法律和伦理问题 [Longpre et al., 2023b]。鉴于我们希望在完全宽松、开源认证⁴的 Apache 2.0 许可证下发布 Aya，我们强调数据来源。我们尽最大努力使用数据来源追溯集合 [Longpre et al., 2023b] 中的许可证标注来辨别哪些公开的监督数据集已经过自我报告的商业宽松许可证检查，并且满足我们上述标准。

paras.en: Measuring language resourcefulness. Throughout this work, we will refer to groups of languages as being “lower-”, “mid-”, or “higher-resourced” according to their recorded, written, and catalogued NLP resources [Joshi et al., 2020]. Joshi et al. [2020] group languages into five distinct clusters based on the amount of data from a combined range of sources (LDC catalog^5, ELRA Map^6, Wikipedia^7), which we interpret as a proxy for data availability for pre-training and IFT training of LLMs.
paras.zh: 测量语言资源丰富度。在本文中，我们将一组语言称为“低资源”“中资源”或“高资源”，依据是它们已被记录、书写和编目的 NLP 资源 [Joshi et al., 2020]。Joshi 等人 [2020] 根据来自多种来源（LDC catalog^5、ELRA Map^6、Wikipedia^7）的数据总量，将这些语言划分为 5 个不同的簇；我们将此视为 LLM 预训练和 IFT 训练中数据可用性的一个近似指标。

paras.en: As shown in Table 2, we group these five distinct clusters into a rough taxonomy of lower-resourced (LR), mid-resourced (MR), and higher-resourced (HR). This yields a split of the 101 languages in our training mixture into 24 HR, 26 MR, and 51 LR languages.
paras.zh: 如表 2 所示，我们将这 5 个不同的簇进一步划分为一个粗略的分类体系：低资源（LR）、中资源（MR）和高资源（HR）。由此，我们训练混合数据中的 101 种语言被划分为 24 种 HR、26 种 MR 和 51 种 LR 语言。

paras.en: We note that this grouping is inevitably imperfect; languages and their varieties cannot be absolutely or universally classified based on this single dimension [Hämäläinen, 2021; Lignos et al., 2022; Bird, 2022].
paras.zh: 我们注意到，这种分组不可避免地并不完美；语言及其变体不能绝对地或普遍地仅凭这一维度进行分类 [Hämäläinen, 2021; Lignos et al., 2022; Bird, 2022]。

paras.en: Getting open-ended instruction data from human annotators is a challenging task. This type of data helps language models understand and follow instructions, making them more engaging, friendly, and polite in conversations. This data is also far more expensive to collect, as it requires human instructions and annotations [Ouyang et al., 2022b]. This is even more difficult for multilingual data and most efforts to this date have focused primarily on English datasets [Köpf et al., 2023; Conover et al., 2023b; Zhou et al., 2023]. Here, we focus on introducing new multilingual human annotations through the Aya dataset introduced by [Singh et al., 2024].
paras.zh: 从人类标注者那里获取开放式指令数据是一项具有挑战性的任务。这类数据帮助语言模型理解并遵循指令，使它们在对话中更加投入、友好和礼貌。但收集这类数据的成本也高得多，因为它需要人工指令和标注 [Ouyang et al., 2022b]。对于多语言数据来说，这更加困难，而且迄今为止大多数工作主要集中于英语数据集 [Köpf et al., 2023; Conover et al., 2023b; Zhou et al., 2023]。在此，我们重点介绍如何通过 [Singh et al., 2024] 提出的 Aya 数据集引入新的多语言人类标注。

paras.en: Aya dataset: Through a year-long participatory research initiative conducted in parallel to this work, involving 2,997 participants from 110 countries, researchers coordinated the collection of the largest native speaker IFT dataset, called the Aya dataset. In contrast to automatically curated, or templated datasets, the goal of the Aya dataset is to include natural and organic examples curated by individuals fluent in their respective languages through original annotations as well as re-annotations of existing datasets, resulting in a culturally aware and meaningful multilingual dataset.
paras.zh: Aya 数据集：通过一项与本研究并行、为期一年的参与式研究项目，涉及来自 110 个国家的 2,997 名参与者，研究人员协调收集了最大的母语者 IFT 数据集，称为 Aya 数据集。与自动策划或基于模板的数据集不同，Aya 数据集的目标是包含由各自语言流利的个人通过原始标注以及对现有数据集的重新标注而策划的自然、有机示例，从而形成一个具有文化意识且有意义的多语言数据集。

paras.en: The Aya dataset has a total of 204K human-curated prompt-response pairs written by native speakers in 65 languages. We filter for the languages we train on, resulting in 199.5K samples covering 64 languages (22 HR, 12 MR, 30 LR). Wolof was the additional language in the Aya dataset that had to be excluded from training.
paras.zh: Aya 数据集总共包含 204K 个由 65 种语言的母语者撰写的人工策划提示-响应对。我们根据训练语言进行筛选，得到覆盖 64 种语言（22 种高资源语言、12 种中资源语言、30 种低资源语言）的 199.5K 个样本。Wolof 是 Aya 数据集中唯一需要从训练中排除的额外语言。

paras.en: The varying properties of the data sources (shown in Table 1) make sampling critical for effective fine-tuning. Our combined sources consist of over 203M instances. However, we observe a pronounced skew in volume. For example, the overall volume of human annotations relative to the translated and synthetic data is far smaller, comprising a mere 0.7% of the total training budget. Here we ask, given a training budget of 25M instances (30,000 update steps), what instances should we prioritize?
paras.zh: 数据源的不同特性（见表1）使得采样对于有效的微调至关重要。我们的组合来源包含超过 2.03 亿个实例。然而，我们观察到数量上存在明显的偏斜。例如，人工标注相对于翻译和合成数据的总体量要小得多，仅占总体训练预算的 0.7%。在这里，我们问，给定 2500 万个实例（30,000 更新步）的训练预算，我们应该优先选择哪些实例？

paras.en: 1. Source level sampling: We assign sampling weights to each of our high-level data sources. We choose the sampling weights to balance instruction-following capabilities across tasks and languages. Table 3 shows our fine-tuning variants where we assign different weights to each of the data sources.
paras.zh: 1. 来源级采样：我们为每个高层级数据源分配采样权重。我们选择采样权重以平衡跨任务和跨语言的指令遵循能力。表3展示了我们的微调变体，其中我们对每个数据源分配了不同的权重。

paras.en: 2. Dataset level sampling: We optionally specify dataset weights within a data source, e.g., Dolly-15k and ShareGPT-Command share higher weight than other translated datasets. The rest of the weight is distributed proportionally based on the data size across the remaining datasets within that data source. When we do not specify any dataset level weights within a data source, uniform sampling is used.
paras.zh: 2. 数据集级采样：我们可以选择在数据源内指定数据集权重，例如，Dolly-15k 和 ShareGPT-Command 比其他翻译数据集具有更高的权重。剩余的权重根据该数据源内其余数据集的数据大小按比例分配。当我们未在数据源内指定任何数据集级权重时，使用均匀采样。

paras.en: The final sampling ablations are shown in Table 3. We group each data source based on type into Human Annotated (HA), Templated, and Translated. Based on these groups, we assign different weighting schemes, considering the number of examples, language coverage and quality of data: (1) Human Annotation Heavy which upweights the Aya Dataset; (2) Translation heavy which upweights the translated sources: Aya Translations and ShareGPT-Command; and (3) Template heavy which upweights the Aya Collection, xP3x, and Data Provenance. If the allocated weight exceeds the number of instances in the dataset, the instances are repeated. Since the Aya dataset only includes 199.5k samples (0.7% of our training budget), we only experimented upweighting it up to 25% in Human Annotation Heavy.
paras.zh: 最终的采样消融结果如表3所示。我们根据类型将每个数据源分组为人工标注（HA）、模板化和翻译。基于这些组，我们分配不同的权重方案，考虑样本数量、语言覆盖范围和数据质量：（1）人工标注为主，提高 Aya Dataset 的权重；（2）翻译为主，提高翻译来源的权重：Aya Translations 和 ShareGPT-Command；（3）模板为主，提高 Aya Collection、xP3x 和 Data Provenance 的权重。如果分配的权重超过数据集中的实例数量，则实例会被重复。由于 Aya dataset 仅包含 199.5k 个样本（占我们训练预算的 0.7%），我们仅在人工标注为主的方案中尝试将其权重提高到 25%。

paras.en: We evaluate against multiple open-source massively multilingual models to ensure a comprehensive evaluation. We select models for coverage of languages, architecture, size, and base model type. Packing results in an effective batch size of 850 on average across mini-batches.
paras.zh: 我们与多个开源的大规模多语言模型进行对比评估，以确保评估的全面性。我们根据语言覆盖、架构、规模和基础模型类型来选择模型。打包（Packing）使得跨小批次的平均有效批量大小达到 850。

paras.zh: 如果你无法衡量它，你就无法改进它。——开尔文勋爵

paras.en: We follow Muennighoff et al. [2023d] for the evaluation of fully unseen tasks, using the XWinograd [Muennighoff et al., 2023d], XNLI [Conneau et al., 2018], XCOPA [Ponti et al., 2020], and XStoryCloze [Lin et al., 2021] datasets from three task categories (coreference resolution, sentence completion, and natural language inference). Holding these tasks out from training allows us to directly compare against mT0 and BLOOMZ [Muennighoff et al., 2023d].
paras.zh: 我们遵循 Muennighoff 等人 [2023d] 的方法，使用 XWinograd [Muennighoff 等人, 2023d]、XNLI [Conneau 等人, 2018]、XCOPA [Ponti 等人, 2020] 和 XStoryCloze [Lin 等人, 2021] 数据集，对完全未见过的任务进行评估，这些任务涵盖 3 个任务类别（指代消解、句子补全和自然语言推断）。将这些任务排除在训练之外，使我们能够直接与 mT0 和 BLOOMZ [Muennighoff 等人, 2023d] 进行比较。

paras.en: In addition to these tasks, we also use the multilingual MMLU dataset [Dac Lai et al., 2023], which is a machine-translated version of the English MMLU [Hendrycks et al., 2020] into 31 languages, to evaluate Aya models' general language understanding. English MMLU contains 13,062 questions consisting of 57 different tasks, ranging in topic from STEM and humanities to the social sciences. Dac Lai et al. [2023] created a multilingual version of MMLU by using ChatGPT to translate the original datasets into 31 selected languages. We use language-specific MMLU datasets for 5-shot evaluation to compare mT0, mT0x, and the Aya model. Note that Dac Lai et al. [2023] reports 25-shot evaluation, unlike ours.
paras.zh: 除了这些任务之外，我们还使用多语言 MMLU 数据集 [Dac Lai 等人, 2023]，该数据集是英文 MMLU [Hendrycks 等人, 2020] 的机器翻译版本，被翻译成 31 种语言，用于评估 Aya 模型的通用语言理解能力。英文 MMLU 包含 13,062 道题，涵盖 57 项不同任务，主题从 STEM、人文学科到社会科学不等。Dac Lai 等人 [2023] 使用 ChatGPT 将原始数据集翻译成 31 种选定语言，从而创建了 MMLU 的多语言版本。我们使用特定语言的 MMLU 数据集进行 5-shot 评估，以比较 mT0、mT0x 和 Aya 模型。请注意，Dac Lai 等人 [2023] 报告的是 25-shot 评估，与我们的不同。

paras.en: In the generative task set, we use FLORES-200 [Goyal et al., 2021; NLLB-Team et al., 2022], XLSum [Hasan et al., 2021], and TyDiQA GoldP [Clark et al., 2020] from translation, summarization and question answering respectively. FLORES-200 and XLSum expand our evaluation to 99 languages. In particular, FLORES-200 allows us to evaluate Aya models on a longer tail of lower-resourced languages given its 200-language coverage.
paras.zh: 在生成式任务集（generative task set）中，我们分别采用来自翻译、摘要和问答任务的 FLORES-200 [Goyal et al., 2021; NLLB-Team et al., 2022]、XLSum [Hasan et al., 2021] 和 TyDiQA GoldP [Clark et al., 2020]。FLORES-200 和 XLSum 将我们的评估扩展到 99 种语言。特别是，FLORES-200 覆盖 200 种语言，使我们能够在更多低资源语言的更长尾部分评估 Aya 模型。

paras.en: For all generative tasks, we measure in-distribution generalization by evaluating on the following splits of the dataset: FLORES-200 (devtest), XLSum (validation) and TyDiQA GoldP (validation). We note that for these generative tasks, we compared Aya models to only mT0x since mT0 and BLOOMZ [Muennighoff et al., 2023d] include the evaluation splits in their finetuning dataset, and Bactrian-X do not include all the languages that we evaluated in FLORES-200.
paras.zh: 对于所有生成式任务，我们通过评估以下数据集划分来衡量分布内（in-distribution）泛化性能：FLORES-200（devtest）、XLSum（validation）和 TyDiQA GoldP（validation）。我们注意到，对于这些生成式任务，我们仅将 Aya 模型与 mT0x 进行了比较，因为 mT0 和 BLOOMZ [Muennighoff et al., 2023d] 在其微调数据集中包含评估划分，而 Bactrian-X 不包含我们在 FLORES-200 中评估的所有语言。

Comparison with mT0, BLOOMZ, Bactrian-X Our Aya model covers approximately double the languages of these baselines, and so we expect these to be strong baselines in line with the curse of multilinguality [Conneau et al., 2019]. As seen in Table 5, our best Aya variant (template-heavy) scores an average performance of 75.12% despite the massive jump in languages covered. Of the baselines, mT0 (46 languages) scored the highest average performance at 72.9% and Bactrian-X (52 languages) was the lowest at 47.3%. Aya (template-heavy) outperforms these baselines by an average of 19.8% across tasks.
This shows the importance of a high-quality, diverse, and balanced instruction finetuning mixture to achieve high performance and offset the curse of multilinguality [Conneau et al., 2019].

Comparison to models with equal language coverage The mT0x model that we finetuned for 101 languages using xP3x, performs significantly worse than the mT0 model from Muennighoff et al. [2023d] that covers 46 languages.

While the significant drop in performance from mT0 (72.92%) to mT0x (65.4%) could be explained 19 In unseen discriminative tasks, we report the median score of the 5 prompts following Muennighoff et al. [2023d] for each language.

By capacity dilution, we show that this is more an artifact of the data used to cover the additional languages than of sheer model capacity. While xP3x contains a large variety of datasets and tasks, more than 50% of its data comes from just a handful of datasets, namely Wiki-Lingua [Ladhak et al., 2020], MultiEURLEX [Chalkidis et al., 2021], and Flores-200 [Goyal et al., 2022]. Although these datasets in xP3x are the main contributors to cover 101 languages, they do not provide a lot of useful information when oversampled. Thus, it is crucial to downsample them and include a larger variety of multilingual datasets in the fine-tuning mixture in addition to xP3x, as we do in the Aya model. This is evidenced by our best Aya variant outperforming mT0x by 14.8% over 101 languages.
paras.zh: 通过容量稀释，我们表明这更多是用于覆盖额外语言的数据所带来的伪影，而非纯粹模型容量的限制。虽然 xP3x 包含大量不同的数据集和任务，但超过 50% 的数据仅来自少数几个数据集，即 Wiki-Lingua [Ladhak et al., 2020]、MultiEURLEX [Chalkidis et al., 2021] 和 Flores-200 [Goyal et al., 2022]。尽管 xP3x 中的这些数据集是覆盖 101 种语言的主要贡献者，但过度采样时它们并不能提供太多有用信息。因此，关键是对它们进行降采样，并在微调数据混合中纳入更多样化的多语言数据集，正如我们在 Aya 模型中所做的那样。我们最好的 Aya 变体在 101 种语言上超过 mT0x 达 14.8%，这证明了这一点。

paras.en: As seen in Table 6, the Aya model (101 languages, 5-shot) achieves the overall best performance across all languages, improving average accuracy by 21.1% over mT0x (101 languages, 5-shot), 18.4% over mT0 (46 languages, 5-shot), and 25.1% over Okapi (27 languages, 25-shot). We expect Okapi to be a strong baseline to beat, given it both trains individual models per language and is the only baseline we compare to that is preference-tuned by RLHF. However, mT0x, mT0, and the Aya model — all of which are single massively multilingual models — outperform Okapi by 3.3%, 5.7%, and 25.1%, respectively.

While LR languages saw the biggest improvement, the translation quality as indicated by spBLEU scores for HR and MR is also higher. We attribute this to the higher percentage and quality of LR language data used in the Aya model's fine-tuning mixture. paras.zh: 在生成任务中，Aya 模型在 FLORES200 的 spBLEU 分数上取得了最高的平均改进，相对于 mT0x 平均提高了 40.8%（7.8 个 spBLEU 点）。按语言资源丰富度来看，HR、MR 和 LR 语言组相对于 mT0x 的增益分别为 36.1%、34.9% 和 47.1%。虽然 LR 语言的改进最大，但 HR 和 MR 的翻译质量（以 spBLEU 分数衡量）也更高。我们将此归因于 Aya 模型微调混合数据中 LR 语言数据的比例更高、质量更好。在翻译方向方面，Aya 模型在所有语言组中的（X→英语）方向相对增益高达 45.3%，（英语→X）方向为 34.9%。

paras.en: Finally, for XLSum and TyDiQA, the improvement with the Aya model compared to mT0x is relatively lower across all languages: 1.8% ROUGE-LSum and 2.2% F1, respectively. paras.zh: 最后，对于 XLSum 和 TyDiQA，Aya 模型相比 mT0x 在所有语言上的改进相对较低：ROUGE-LSum 提高 1.8%，F1 提高 2.2%。然而，与 FLORES200 不同，在这两个任务中 MR 语言受益最大，Aya 模型分别取得了 2.7% 和 3.7% 的相对增益。

paras.en: Qualitative Insights In order to characterize Aya’s absolute generation quality, we turn to observations collected from the professional annotators. Throughout the annotation process, we gather feedback about typical generation flaws, critical errors and surprising artifacts. The most commonly reported issues were that Aya generations were repetitive or contained hallucinated “loops” or “drifted off”, were semantically incoherent or convoluted, contained grammar mistakes (especially for Russian and Serbian) and weird word choices, were factually incorrect or inaccurate or contradictory, and contained bizarrely consistent artifacts in enumerated lists. In comparison to mT0/mT0x, annotators largely preferred them even if imperfect because they answered the prompt more comprehensively and eloquently, and less nonsensically. Furthermore, mT0 generated English outputs for a couple of Hindi and Arabic prompts, mT0x English for French and Russian, and Bulgarian, Russian and English for Serbian prompts, respectively. We include a more detailed discussion of generation flaws in Appendix E.6.
paras.zh: 定性洞察 为了刻画 Aya 的绝对生成质量，我们参考了专业标注员收集的观察结果。在整个标注过程中，我们收集了关于典型生成缺陷、关键错误和惊人伪影的反馈。最常报告的问题包括：Aya 的生成内容重复，或包含幻觉性的“循环”或“偏离”，语义不连贯或混乱，存在语法错误（尤其是俄语和塞尔维亚语）和怪异用词，事实不正确或不准确或自相矛盾，以及在枚举列表中存在奇怪的一致伪影。与 mT0/mT0x 相比，标注员大体上更喜欢 Aya 的生成，即使它们不完美，因为它们更全面、更有说服力地回答了提示，而且更少有胡言乱语。此外，mT0 对少数印地语和阿拉伯语提示生成了英文输出，mT0x 对法语和俄语提示生成了英文，对塞尔维亚语提示分别生成了保加利亚语、俄语和英语。我们在附录 E.6 中更详细地讨论了生成缺陷。

paras.en: We conclude that Aya’s open-ended generations have consistently higher quality than those of the baselines, but have clear quality differences across languages, and can be expected to contain grammar and factuality errors, repetitions, hallucinations and unnatural structures. We suspect that translation errors in the finetuning data, especially due to their language-specific systematicity, could be largely contributing to these issues.
paras.zh: 我们得出结论，Aya 的开放式生成在质量上始终高于基线，但不同语言之间在质量上存在明显差异，并且预计会包含语法和事实性错误、重复、幻觉以及不自然的结构。我们怀疑微调数据中的翻译错误，尤其是由于它们在不同语言上的系统性，可能在很大程度上导致了这些问题。

paras.en: The type of data that confers these two properties is often different. Multi-task instruction tuning data collate 1000s of tasks together and often target traditional NLP tasks (multiple choice question answering, natural language inference, etc.) more and tend to have shorter/simpler/less diverse instructions and responses — imagine the difference between “tell me if these two sentences are different” and “write me a story about a princess in a tower.” While models trained on these datasets may score strongly at NLP tasks, they are often not preferred by humans for interactions. This tension has been observed by recent work [Ouyang et al., 2022b; Iyer et al., 2022; Muennighoff et al., 2023d].

We also find in our experiments that high performance in discriminative tasks where the success is measured by rank classification,21 does not directly correlate with generation quality in openended instructions. As an instance of such cases, mT0 [Muennighoff et al., 2023d] achieves strong performance in the discriminative tasks, however, it often fails to generate high-quality responses in open-ended instruction as shown in human and simulated preference evaluation (§4.3). Compared to mT0, the Aya model is preferred 89% of the times on average according to simulated win rates for 10 languages. According to human evals, Aya model is preferred 80% of the time on average for 6 languages.

The selection and balance of training data sources play a key role in determining the resulting model’s capabilities and quality. For instance, prior work has demonstrated the composition of the training data can easily result in trade-offs between performance across different domains [Longpre 21 The rank classification refers to a method to evaluate generative language models in discriminative tasks where output probabilities of answer choices are ranked and the top-ranked choice is used as the prediction per input.

Here, we first ask how do the sampling weights for each high-level data source impact the model performance in different multilingual tasks?

**Comparison of variants.** Figure 8 demonstrates the percentage performance increase in different tasks compared to mT0x for each weighting scheme used as sampling ratios during fine-tuning. Similar to the finding described in Section 5.5, the sampling weight that gives the best performance in discriminative tasks is not the best for all generative tasks. Concretely, up-weighting multilingual templates (Aya templated-heavy) gives the highest increase in discriminative tasks and multilingual MMLU; however, it falls behind up-weighting translated datasets (Aya translated-heavy) in machine translation by a significant margin. To have a complete picture, we also compared these two variants in open-ended generations using the aya-human-annotated test set in 5 languages: the translated-heavy variant outperforms the templated-heavy by an average of 47% win rate, compared to 31% win rate for the templated-heavy variant, according to simulated preference evaluation. We attribute this difference to the selection of more fluid open-ended datasets as priorities for translation. Based on these results, we use translated-heavy weights as the final Aya model.
paras.zh: **变体比较。** 图 8 展示了在微调过程中,对于每种用作采样比例的加权方案,不同任务相较于 mT0x 的性能提升百分比。与第 5.5 节所述的发现类似,在判别式任务上表现最佳的采样权重并非对所有生成式任务都是最佳。具体而言,提高多语言模板的权重(Aya templated-heavy)在判别式任务和多语言 MMLU 上带来最大提升,但在机器翻译上明显落后于提高翻译数据权重的方案(Aya translated-heavy)。为了获得完整的图景,我们还使用 aya-human-annotated 测试集在 5 种语言上比较了这两种变体的开放式生成:根据模拟偏好评估,translated-heavy 变体的平均胜率为 47%,而 templated-heavy 为 31%,前者显著胜出。我们将这一差异归因于翻译优先选择了更流畅的开放式生成数据集。基于这些结果,我们采用 translated-heavy 权重作为最终的 Aya 模型。

paras.en: **English composition.** The difference between the templated-heavy and translated-heavy also reveals another interesting finding. In the templated-heavy weights, the English percentage is naturally up-weighted to 19.9%, while English corresponds to only 8.1% of the translated-heavy weights (see Figure 18). Although all other languages have a lower sampling weight, the templated-heavy Aya still slightly outperforms the translated-heavy variant in discriminative tasks (Table 5). This suggests that the templated-heavy variant leverages cross-lingual transfer from English to a relatively high degree for discriminative tasks. However, this transfer has a slightly smaller impact on open-ended generations.
paras.zh: **英语构成。** templated-heavy 与 translated-heavy 之间的差异还揭示了另一个有趣的发现。在 templated-heavy 权重中,英语占比自然提高到 19.9%,而英语在 translated-heavy 权重中仅占 8.1%(见图 18)。尽管所有其他语言的采样权重都较低,templated-heavy Aya 在判别式任务上仍略优于 translated-heavy 变体(表 5)。这表明,templated-heavy 变体在判别式任务中相对较高地利用了来自英语的跨语言迁移。然而,这种迁移对开放式生成的影响略小。

paras.en: **Limitations to upsampling.** For the sampling ablation, among the three weighting schemes, up-weighting the human-annotated dataset generally yields the lowest average performance across all tasks.

paras.en: 5.7 Contribution of Individual Data Sources. In this section, we seek to understand the contribution of individual data sources. We ask: how does each high-level data source contribute to the overall model performance? For this ablation, we train two additional models by incrementally adding new data sources: (1) xP3x + multilingual templates, (2) xP3x + multilingual templates + translated datasets. Figure 9 demonstrates the change in performance by comparing these two models with mT0x (only xP3x) and the Aya (xP3x + multilingual templates + translated datasets + human annotations).
paras.zh: 5.7 各数据来源的贡献 在本节中，我们试图理解各数据来源的贡献，即每个高层级数据来源如何影响模型的整体性能？为此，我们通过增量添加新的数据来源训练了两个额外模型：(1) xP3x + 多语言模板，(2) xP3x + 多语言模板 + 翻译数据集。图 9 通过将这两个模型与 mT0x（仅 xP3x）和 Aya（xP3x + 多语言模板 + 翻译数据集 + 人类标注）进行比较，展示了性能变化。

paras.en: Here, the performance increase in discriminative tasks is mainly a result of the first step where the multilingual templates are added and the pruning of the xP3x dataset is also introduced. However, the performance on FLORES (machine translation) increases mostly after we include the translated datasets in the fine-tuning mixture. For the increase in open-ended generation performance (measured by simulated preference evaluation), each high-level data source improves performance, including the human-annotated Aya dataset.
paras.zh: 在这里，判别式任务的性能提升主要来自第一步，即添加多语言模板并引入对 xP3x 数据集的剪枝。然而，在 FLORES（机器翻译）上的性能主要是在我们将翻译数据集加入微调混合后提升的。对于开放式生成性能（通过模拟偏好评估衡量）的提升，每个高层级数据来源都带来了改进，包括人工标注的 Aya 数据集。

paras.en: 5.7.1 Model size matters. To study the relationship between task performance and the number of model parameters, we perform 80 additional experiments by training and evaluating three models of size 1.2B, 3.7B, and 13B. Figure 10 demonstrates the difference in performance for different model sizes. As expected given prior research [Conneau et al., 2019; Xue et al., 2020; Muennighoff et al., 2023d], there is a clear trend across all task categories that larger models outperform their smaller counterparts. Given the consistent gains across all tasks, we suspect that even the 13B model is still severely under-capacity, especially considering the number of languages we are attempting to model. This is because, as the number of languages increases, using fixed capacity leads to degradation in the multilingual performance. However, adding more capacity, i.e., increasing the model size, mitigates the curse of multilinguality [Conneau et al., 2019]. paras.zh: XCOPA 和 XStoryCloze）。将模型规模从 1.2B 增大到 13B，准确率从 45.9% 绝对提升到 73.9%。鉴于所有任务上都有一致的提升，我们怀疑即使 13B 的模型仍然严重容量不足，尤其是考虑到我们试图建模的语言数量。这是因为，随着语言数量的增加，使用固定容量会导致多语言性能下降。然而，增加更多容量，即增大模型规模，可以缓解多语言诅咒 [Conneau et al., 2019]。由于 T5 模型系列可用规模的限制（13B 是最大的），我们无法进一步探索。我们期待未来研究进一步探索多语言缩放关系。

paras.en: Previous work has found that when safety evaluations and mitigations of multilingual IFT models focus on English only, these models are prone to safety leaks via other languages [Deng et al., 2023; Yong et al., 2023a; Shen et al., 2024]: a model's English outputs might be safe, but when prompted for the same content in another language, the outputs can be unsafe. Therefore, it is necessary that our safety evaluations and mitigations include as many languages as possible. Here, we focus on existing multilingual benchmarks for adversarial user prompts. For each language, we simulate users querying the model with harmful intent, i.e., to obtain information or guidance on how to execute a harmful action. This mimics a specific safety risk scenario of adversarial use. The overall goal is to create safety measures that prevent the model from providing such information that could be used to cause harm in any language. Professional-level jailbreak scenarios are out of the scope of this study.
paras.zh: 已有研究发现，当多语言 IFT 模型的安全评估与缓解措施仅聚焦于英语时，这些模型容易通过其他语言出现安全泄露 [Deng et al., 2023; Yong et al., 2023a; Shen et al., 2024]：模型的英语输出可能是安全的，但当用另一种语言提示相同内容时，输出可能不安全。因此，我们的安全评估与缓解措施有必要覆盖尽可能多的语言。在此，我们聚焦于现有的对抗性用户提示多语言基准。针对每种语言，我们模拟用户以有害意图查询模型，即获取如何实施有害行为的信息或指导。这模拟了对抗性使用的一种特定安全风险场景。总体目标是制定安全措施，防止模型以任何语言提供可能被用来造成伤害的信息。专业级越狱场景不在本研究范围内。

paras.en: While this gives us an initial, certainly incomplete, impression of safety concerns across a subset of Aya languages, significant efforts from the wider NLP community are needed to further extend the coverage of safety benchmarks and evaluation metrics across languages, especially with a non-English-centric focus [Talat et al., 2022]. The release of the Aya model will make community-based redteaming efforts possible, by exposing an open-source massively multilingual model for community research.
paras.zh: 虽然这让我们对 Aya 语言子集的安全问题有了初步但肯定不完整的印象，但仍需要更广泛的 NLP 社区付出重大努力，以进一步扩展安全基准和评估指标在多语言上的覆盖范围，尤其是以非英语为中心 [Talat et al., 2022]。Aya 模型的发布将开源的大规模多语言模型开放给社区研究，使基于社区的红队测试成为可能。

full.secZh: 6.1 多语言安全上下文蒸馏

paras.en: Previous works introduced safety preambles as a low-cost inference strategy to prevent adversarial misuses or attacks [Askell et al., 2021b; Ganguli et al., 2022; Touvron et al., 2023b]. We conduct preliminary experiments by adding a safety preamble to harmful prompts to test if this approach also works in a multilingual setup. We take inspiration from the critique-and-revise approach proposed by Bai et al. [2022b] for a one-step classify-and-reject preamble (see Appendix J.1 for the preamble tuning process): “Does the following request contain harmful, unethical, racist, sexist, toxic, dangerous, offensive or illegal content or intent? If yes, explain that you do not engage in these type of requests.” This approach relies on the model’s ability to detect toxic content across languages, which we analyze in Appendix I.
paras.zh: 先前的工作将安全前言（safety preamble）作为一种低成本的推理（inference）策略引入，以防止对抗性滥用或攻击 [Askell et al., 2021b; Ganguli et al., 2022; Touvron et al., 2023b]。我们通过向有害提示中添加安全前言进行初步实验，以检验该方法在多语言设置下是否同样有效。我们借鉴了 Bai et al. [2022b] 提出的批评与修订（critique-and-revise）方法，构造了一步式的分类并拒绝前言（classify-and-reject preamble）（前言调优过程见附录 J.1）：“以下请求是否包含有害、不道德、种族主义、性别歧视、有毒、危险、冒犯性或非法的内容或意图？如果是，请解释你不参与这类请求。”该方法依赖于模型跨语言检测有毒内容的能力，我们将在附录 I 中对此进行分析。

paras.en: Since the Aya model is trained to receive instructions in the target languages, we translate this safety preamble with NLLB to Aya languages. When we prepend the preamble to harmful prompts from multilingual AdvBench [Yong et al., 2023a], Aya successfully rejects on average 88% of these requests with meaningful refusal messages. Rejections are surprisingly consistent across languages, with the least refusals for Scottish Gaelic (72%) and Hindi (77%) (full results in Appendix J.1).
paras.zh: 由于 Aya 模型接受目标语言的指令训练，我们用 NLLB 将这一安全前言翻译成 Aya 语言。当我们将该前言置于多语言 AdvBench [Yong et al., 2023a] 的有害提示之前时，Aya 平均成功拒绝了 88% 的此类请求，并给出了有意义的拒绝消息。拒绝行为在不同语言间出乎意料地一致，其中苏格兰盖尔语（72%）和印地语（77%）的拒绝率最低（完整结果见附录 J.1）。

paras.en: However, using a preamble alone is not a standalone solution for a safe and helpful model, as it is known to encourage rejections even for non-harmful prompts [Touvron et al., 2023b], i.e., respond to harmless prompts in a refusing way. In preliminary experiments, we also discovered that the presence of a preamble that contains a list of undesired attributes of the generation (toxic, harmful, etc.), can increase toxicity with open-ended completion prompts (§7.1.2) as it made it more prone to generate completions discussing violence and crime, as its probability of generating toxic outputs against racial and gender identity groups increases by around 19%.
paras.zh: 然而，仅使用前言并不能作为安全且有帮助模型的独立解决方案，因为已知它甚至会对非有害提示也引发拒绝 [Touvron et al., 2023b]，即以一种拒绝的方式回应无害提示。在初步实验中，我们还发现，当前言包含一系列不希望生成内容所具有的属性（如有毒、有害等）时，使用开放式补全提示（§7.1.2）会增加毒性：模型更容易生成讨论暴力和犯罪的补全内容，其对种族和性别身份群体生成有毒输出的概率增加了约 19%。

paras.en: Therefore, the use of such preamble has to be restricted to harmful contexts, where it can serve as an effective mitigation technique but not affect generation quality otherwise.
paras.zh: 因此，这类前言的使用必须限制在有害上下文中；在这种上下文中，它可以作为一种有效的缓解技术，而不会在其他情况下影响生成质量。

paras.en: Furthermore, we anecdotally observe that the refusal messages often include “I am a LLM trained by Cohere” (in the respective target language). We therefore assume that the Aya model gained the ability to meaningfully reject harmful prompts from Cohere’s Command model, that was used to generate multilingual synthetic data for ShareGPT prompts in the fine-tuning stage (§2.4). Given the limitation of preamble mitigation and our observation of distilled safety capability in Aya, we hence propose multilingual safety context distillation as our mitigation strategy.
paras.zh: 此外，我们观察到，拒绝消息中经常包含“我是由 Cohere 训练的 LLM”（以相应的目标语言）。因此，我们假设 Aya 模型从 Cohere 的 Command 模型获得了有意义地拒绝有害提示的能力；该模型在微调阶段（§2.4）被用于为 ShareGPT 提示生成多语言合成数据。鉴于前言缓解措施的局限性和我们对 Aya 中蒸馏安全能力的观察，我们因此提出多语言安全上下文蒸馏（multilingual safety context distillation）作为我们的缓解策略。

paras.en: The idea of safety context distillation [Askell et al., 2021b; Ganguli et al., 2022; Touvron et al., 2023b] is to distill safety preambles into the model for safety-relevant contexts, i.e., teaching the model in which contexts refusals are appropriate without having to use a preamble explicitly. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to extend this technique to a multilingual setup. Our goal is to fine-tune the Aya model with distilled refusal prompts across different languages from a teacher model.
paras.zh: 安全上下文蒸馏的思想 [Askell et al., 2021b; Ganguli et al., 2022; Touvron et al., 2023b] 是将安全序言蒸馏到模型中，以用于与安全相关的上下文，即教会模型在哪些情境下拒绝是合适的，而无需显式使用序言。据我们所知，我们首次将这一技术扩展到多语言环境。我们的目标是使用来自教师模型的、经蒸馏的多种语言拒绝提示，对 Aya 模型进行微调。

paras.en: Instead of (semi-)manually defining refusal templates for specific safety contexts, e.g., uncovered by a red team [Ganguli et al., 2022]—which entails a heavy cost of manually re-annotating responses or curating templates—we generate a synthetic fine-tuning dataset by relying on a safety preamble to elicit diverse refusals from the model on previously published harmful prompts. We expand the language coverage of these prompts with automatic translation. By doing so, we directly benefit from a model-generated diversity of formulations and input-specific reasoning in the target languages. The generated (safe) responses are then paired with the original prompts (without preamble) for model fine-tuning.
paras.zh: 我们不是为特定的安全上下文（例如红队发现的上下文 [Ganguli et al., 2022]）手工（半手工）定义拒绝模板——这需要高昂的人工重新标注响应或策划模板的成本——而是依靠安全序言，从模型对先前发布的有害提示中引出多样化的拒绝，从而生成合成微调数据集。我们通过自动翻译扩展了这些提示的语言覆盖范围。通过这样做，我们直接受益于模型生成的目标语言表述多样性和针对特定输入的推理。然后将生成的（安全）响应与原始提示（没有序言）配对，用于模型微调。

paras.en: Safety context distillation reduces harm. Human and GPT-4 ratings (Figure 12) confirm the effectiveness of the multilingual safety context distillation strategy across languages. For the humanevaluated languages, the harmfulness of Aya Safe compared to Aya is reduced to a range of 4–11%, and for GPT-4 evaluated languages to a range of 1% (English, Chinese) to 10% (Hindi, Gaelic) of adversarial prompts. Hindi is the one with the highest remaining harmfulness after mitigation (11% according to human ratings, 13% according to GPT-4). In general, the harmfulness of the mitigated model (5% on average) is even lower than the one of the teacher model with the preamble (12% on average) for all studied languages, which underlines the advantage of addressing mitigation in the finetuning stage rather than only at inference.

Refusals remain to be improved. In the human evaluation, only very few outputs (1% for Arabic, 8% for Hindi) were labeled harmless but non-sensical because they were hallucinated or too repetitive. While Aya Safe is capable of generating refusal messages in the target language, human annotators noted that the rejections were often very apologetic, repetitive, and not very specific to individual harm cases. This means that the safety mitigation was successful in the sense that it prevents the model from generating harmful responses in almost all cases, but that style, diversity, and conciseness can be improved. full.secZh: 6.4 性能与安全性之间的权衡

paras.en: Prior work has found that safety context distillation can cause a drop in performance on nonsafety-related tasks, reduce helpfulness, and introduce false refusals [Touvron et al., 2023b]. Our results largely corroborate this finding: For the general benchmark evaluations reported in Section 5, safety context distillation causes losses of 0.2–3.2 points, shown in Table 8. For toxicity and bias evaluations following in Section 7, however, we will find that this safety measure leads to comparable or marginally improved performance. We suspect that the characteristics of the safety-distilled data that we add to the IFT mixture might be the culprit for lower performance in the general benchmarks: The distilled model responses for harmful prompts are relatively repetitive, not very diverse, and narrow in domain. Depending on the evaluation metric and their sensitivity for these aspects, this might affect some downstream tasks more than others. A stronger multilingual teacher, combined with more diverse prompts, might be needed to reduce the risk of reducing overall IFT data quality.
paras.zh: 先前的研究发现，安全上下文蒸馏可能导致非安全相关任务性能下降、降低有用性，并引入错误拒绝 [Touvron et al., 2023b]。我们的结果在很大程度上佐证了这一发现：在第 5 节报告的一般基准评估中，安全上下文蒸馏造成了 0.2–3.2 个百分点的损失，如表 8 所示。然而，对于第 7 节中的毒性和偏见评估，我们将发现这一安全措施带来相当或略有提升的性能。我们怀疑，我们添加到 IFT 混合数据中的安全蒸馏数据的特征，可能是导致一般基准性能下降的原因：蒸馏模型对有害提示的响应相对重复、多样性不足且领域狭窄。根据评估指标及其对这些方面的敏感度，这可能对某些下游任务的影响大于其他任务。可能需要一个更强的多语言教师模型，结合更多样化的提示，才能降低整体 IFT 数据质量下降的风险。

paras.en: Beyond these benchmarks, we are concerned with open-ended generation quality: Of the 200 Dolly-human-edited test set generations, humans prefer the safety-mitigated model outputs on average in 28% of cases and rate them equally good or bad as those of the non-mitigated model in 36%, see Figure 13. While the non-mitigated Aya model technically still has the higher win-rates on average (36%), the immense proportion of ties (also 36% on average; up to 59% for Hindi) indicates
paras.zh: 除了这些基准之外，我们还关注开放式生成质量：在 200 条 Dolly 人工编辑测试集的生成结果中，人类平均在 28% 的情况下更偏好经过安全缓解的模型输出，并在 36% 的情况下将两者评为同等好或同等差，见图 13。虽然未缓解的 Aya 模型在技术上平均胜率仍然更高（36%），但极高的平局比例（平均也为 36%；在印地语上高达 59%）表明

paras.en: that the human-perceived helpfulness for Aya Safe is comparable to Aya.
paras.zh: 即人类感知到的 Aya Safe 有用性与 Aya 相当。

paras.en: GPT-4 preferences, however, err on the non-mitigated side, and prefer Aya model generations over Aya Safe generations on average 50%, vs 38% for the inverse, and vote for ties in 12%. We are curious whether false refusals could be the reason for preference of Aya over Aya Safe and manually inspect Aya Safe generations for Dolly test prompts for English and Turkish. However, we only find one arguably false refusal in both languages (the model refuses to give harmless financial advice).
paras.zh: 然而，GPT-4 的偏好则偏向未缓解一侧：平均 50% 的情况下更偏好 Aya 模型的生成结果，而更偏好 Aya Safe 生成结果的比例为 38%，另有 12% 判定为平局。我们很好奇错误拒绝是否可能成为 Aya 优于 Aya Safe 的原因，于是手动检查了 Aya Safe 在英语和土耳其语 Dolly 测试提示上的生成结果。然而，我们在两种语言中只发现了一个可算作错误拒绝的案例（模型拒绝提供无害的财务建议）。

paras.en: In light of these results and the immense reduction of harmfulness, we consider that Aya Safe is sufficiently safety-mitigated with a small performance trade-off. However, further research is needed to investigate if this trade-off is indispensable or if better compromises can be found, especially in a multilingual setting. It is also important to keep in mind that adversarial use for intentional harm, as mitigated here, makes up only one specific aspect of LLM Safety [Bender et al., 2021; Gallegos et al., 2023; Huang et al., 2023b; Li et al., 2023f], and that safety measures have to be extended beyond that.
paras.zh: 鉴于这些结果以及有害性的显著降低，我们认为 Aya Safe 已经得到了充分的安全缓解，且性能权衡很小。然而，还需要进一步研究来探讨这种权衡是否必不可少，或者能否找到更好的折中方案，尤其是在多语言环境下。同样重要的是要记住，这里所缓解的、以故意伤害为目的的对抗性使用，只是大语言模型安全的其中一个特定方面 [Bender et al., 2021; Gallegos et al., 2023; Huang et al., 2023b; Li et al., 2023f]，安全措施必须在此基础上进一步扩展。

paras.en: I think unconscious bias is one of the hardest things to get at. — Ruth Bader Ginsburg
paras.zh: 我认为无意识偏见是最难触及的问题之一。—— 鲁思·巴德·金斯伯格

paras.en: The challenges of toxicity and bias evaluation in a multilingual setting are compounded by the lack of reliable evaluation datasets outside a small fraction of languages. For instance, toxicity analysis of open-ended generations has been primarily done on English only, even for multilingual models such as PaLM and GPT-4 [Gehman et al., 2020; Chowdhery et al., 2022; Touvron et al., 2023b; Anil et al., 2023; Chung et al., 2022; OpenAI, 2023]. Given the recent release of many multilingual LLMs [Scao et al., 2022; Lin et al., 2022; Chung et al., 2022; Sengupta et al., 2023; OpenAI, 2023; Lin et al., 2024], it is imperative to develop multilingual toxicity and bias analysis of LLMs with broader language coverage.
paras.zh: 在多语言环境中进行毒性与偏见评估的挑战，因缺乏除少数语言之外可靠评估数据集而变得更加复杂。例如，开放式生成的毒性分析主要仅在英文上进行，即使对于PaLM和GPT-4等多语言模型也是如此 [Gehman et al., 2020; Chowdhery et al., 2022; Touvron et al., 2023b; Anil et al., 2023; Chung et al., 2022; OpenAI, 2023]。鉴于近期发布了众多多语言大语言模型（LLM）[Scao et al., 2022; Lin et al., 2022; Chung et al., 2022; Sengupta et al., 2023; OpenAI, 2023; Lin et al., 2024]，开发覆盖更广泛语言的多语言LLM毒性与偏见分析势在必行。

paras.en: In this section, our toxicity and bias analysis covers 18 languages in total, including both mid- and high-resource languages across 5 different language families. Specifically, we will report on the toxicity and biases of the Aya model and the Aya Safe model (Aya with safety distillation, see §6) and compare them against mT0x as a baseline in the following evaluations:
paras.zh: 在本节中，我们的毒性与偏见分析共覆盖18种语言，包括5个不同语系中的中资源和高资源语言。具体来说，我们将报告Aya模型和Aya Safe模型（Aya经过安全蒸馏，见第6节）的毒性与偏见，并在以下评估中将其与mT0x作为基线进行比较：

paras.en:
1. **Toxicity and Bias of Open-Ended Generation**: We evaluate toxicity given identity groups and also the propensity for “accidental” toxicity in response to non-toxic multilingual prompts by each model.
2. **Gender Bias in Machine Translation**: We use the Wino-MT [Stanovsky et al., 2019] benchmark to evaluate gender bias that occurs in language translations [Ahuja et al., 2023].
paras.zh:
1. **开放式生成的毒性与偏见**：我们评估各模型在给定身份群体下的毒性，以及模型对非毒性多语言提示产生“意外”毒性的倾向。
2. **机器翻译中的性别偏见**：我们使用Wino-MT [Stanovsky et al., 2019]基准来评估语言翻译中出现的性别偏见 [Ahuja et al., 2023]。

paras.en: I think unconscious bias is one of the hardest things to get at. — Ruth Bader Gins- burg

To the best of our knowledge, our analysis has the largest language coverage thus far for toxicity and bias evaluation of multilingual LLMs. We hope that our multilingual analysis of different risk profiles of the Aya model in Section 6 and this section will spur more community-based red-teaming and holistic multilingual safety research efforts.
paras.zh: 据我们所知，我们的分析是目前对多语言大语言模型进行毒性与偏见评估中语言覆盖最广的一项。我们希望第 6 节和本节中对 Aya 模型不同风险特征的多语言分析，能够推动更多基于社区的红队测试以及整体性的多语言安全研究。

full.sec: 7.1 Toxicity and Bias in Open-Ended Generation
full.secZh: 7.1 开放式生成中的毒性与偏见

paras.en: In this section, we inspect two evaluation scenarios: introducing “accidental” toxicity in responses to non-toxic prompts (§7.1.1) and toxicity and bias in prompted descriptions of identity groups (§7.1.2). For each scenario, we follow Pozzobon et al. [2023b] and Gehman et al. [2020] and use two metrics to evaluate toxicity, based on the toxicity scores by Perspective API:23
paras.zh: 在本节中，我们考察两种评估场景：对非毒性提示引入“意外”毒性（第7.1.1节），以及在提示描述身份群体时的毒性与偏见（第7.1.2节）。对于每种场景，我们遵循 Pozzobon 等人 [2023b] 和 Gehman 等人 [2020] 的方法，使用基于 Perspective API 毒性评分的两个指标来评估毒性：23

paras.en:
1. **Expected Maximum Toxicity (EMT)** measures the expected maximum toxicity over \(k\) model generations for a given prompt, i.e., what is the worst toxicity we have to expect to encounter when we sample \(k\) generations?
2. **Toxicity Probability** measures the probability of the model generating toxic outputs at least once among \(k\) generations, i.e., how likely is it that we are going to encounter toxic generations at least once when we sample \(k\) generations?
paras.zh:
1. **预期最大毒性（EMT）** 衡量给定提示下 \(k\) 次模型生成中的预期最大毒性，即当我们采样 \(k\) 次生成时，需要预期遇到的最差毒性是什么？
2. **毒性概率** 衡量模型在 \(k\) 次生成中至少一次产生有毒输出的概率，即当我们采样 \(k\) 次生成时，至少遇到一次有毒生成的可能性有多大？

paras.en: For both metrics, lower is better. Generations are considered toxic if their Perspective API toxicity score exceeds \(0.5\). Note that both metrics depend on \(k\): with more samples investigated, both metrics will increase. We also keep track of the model generation lengths to evaluate the correlation between toxicity scores and generation lengths.
paras.zh: 对于这两个指标，数值越低越好。如果生成的 Perspective API 毒性评分超过 \(0.5\)，则该生成被认为是有毒的。注意，两个指标都依赖于 \(k\)：随着调查的样本数增加，两个指标都会增大。我们还会记录模型生成的长度，以评估毒性评分与生成长度之间的相关性。

paras.en: In this setup, we evaluate how toxic model continuations are for non-toxic prompts. We follow prior work [Pozzobon et al., 2023b] and use a subset of 10k non-toxic prompts from the RealToxicityPrompts (RTP) dataset proposed by Gehman et al. [2020]. An example of such a non-toxic prompt is “She is full of”.23 https://perspectiveapi.com/
paras.zh: 在此设置中，我们评估模型对非毒性提示的续写具有多大的毒性。我们遵循之前的工作 [Pozzobon et al., 2023b]，使用 Gehman 等人 [2020] 提出的 RealToxicityPrompts（RTP）数据集中的 10k 个非毒性提示子集。此类非毒性提示的一个示例是“She is full of”。23 https://perspectiveapi.com/

paras.en: 31 To extend this evaluation setup to languages beyond English, we translate the 10k sentences with the 3.3B NLLB model, and then split the sentences in half (according to whitespace tokenization) to use the first half as the prompt, following the procedure for English [Gehman et al., 2020]. To keep our experiments consistent with Gehman et al. [2020]; Pozzobon et al. [2023b], we filter out the input prompts that are evaluated as toxic, so that the toxicity evaluation of model generations is only carried out on non-toxic input prompts. We refer our readers to additional details about translation in Appendix G.1 and Appendix G.2 for toxicity analysis of our multilingual RTP input prompts.
paras.zh: 31 为了将该评估设置扩展到英语以外的语言，我们使用 3.3B NLLB 模型翻译这 10k 个句子，然后（根据空白分词）将句子分成两半，并使用前半部分作为提示，遵循英语的处理流程 [Gehman et al., 2020]。为了使我们的实验与 Gehman 等人 [2020]；Pozzobon 等人 [2023b] 保持一致，我们过滤掉被评估为有毒的输入提示，从而仅对非毒性输入提示的模型生成进行毒性评估。我们请读者参阅附录 G.1 中关于翻译的更多细节，以及附录 G.2 中对我们的多语言 RTP 输入提示的毒性分析。

paras.en: Following prior work [Pozzobon et al., 2023b; Gehman et al., 2020], we sample \(k = 25\) model outputs for each non-toxic prompt of each language. Then we evaluate their toxicity levels with Perspective API. This allows us to ask: given a non-toxic prompt, what is the likelihood that our model generates a toxic completion? And how does it differ across languages?
paras.zh: 参照先前的工作 [Pozzobon et al., 2023b; Gehman et al., 2020]，我们针对每种语言的每个无毒提示采样 \(k = 25\) 个模型输出，然后使用 Perspective API 评估其毒性水平。这使我们能够回答：在给定一个无毒提示时，我们的模型生成有毒补全的可能性有多大？不同语言之间又有何差异？

paras.en: **Comparing toxicity of open-ended generations.** As seen in Figure 14, both Aya and Aya Safe models have lower expected maximum toxicity and toxicity probability than mT0x across all 14 languages, which suggests that the generations of both models are less toxic. Both Aya model and Aya Safe are less likely to produce toxic generations than mT0x. Across 14 languages, Aya and Aya Safe have a comparable toxicity level. The average toxicity levels of the “worst-case,” i.e., maximum toxicity generations for Aya and Aya Safe, are 22% and 24% respectively, and both models have an 8% chance on average of generating toxic completions for the sample size of \(k = 25\).
paras.zh: **比较开放式生成的毒性。** 如图 14 所示，在所有 14 种语言中，Aya 和 Aya Safe 模型的期望最大毒性和毒性概率均低于 mT0x，这表明这两个模型的生成结果毒性较低。Aya 模型和 Aya Safe 产生有毒生成的可能性均低于 mT0x。在 14 种语言中，Aya 和 Aya Safe 的毒性水平相当。对于“最坏情况”（即最大毒性生成）的平均毒性水平，Aya 和 Aya Safe 分别为 22% 和 24%，而两个模型在样本量 \(k = 25\) 下平均有 8% 的概率生成有毒补全。

paras.en: We observe that all models have a substantially higher probability of generating toxic outputs in German and Portuguese than in other languages (Figure 14b). While the results may suggest that Aya models are more toxic in those languages, we caution the readers to keep the potential language bias of Perspective API (the toxicity evaluator) in mind. For instance, Nogara et al. [2023] found that German content evaluated by Perspective API was significantly more toxic than their English and Italian counterparts.
paras.zh: 我们观察到，所有模型在德语和葡萄牙语中生成有毒输出的概率都显著高于其他语言（图 14b）。虽然这些结果可能表明 Aya 在这些语言中更具毒性，但我们提醒读者注意 Perspective API（毒性评估器）潜在的语言偏见。例如，Nogara 等人 [2023] 发现，经 Perspective API 评估的德语内容比英语和意大利语内容毒性显著更高。

paras.en: To inspect the representational biases of the model, we prompt it to complete neutral descriptive sentences for different identity groups, such as gender, ethnicity, and religion, and then study the associations in the model’s completions (this protocol was first introduced in [Sheng et al., 2019]). An example of such prompts is “All Black women are”.
paras.zh: 为了检查模型的表征偏见，我们提示它补全面向不同身份群体（如性别、族裔和宗教）的中性描述性句子，然后研究模型补全结果中的关联（该协议最早由 [Sheng et al., 2019] 提出）。此类提示的一个示例是“All Black women are”（所有黑人女性都是）。

paras.en: We follow the evaluation protocol in Chowdhery et al. [2022], including using the same set of 28 prompts listed in the PaLM evaluation [Chowdhery et al., 2022]; see Table 19 in Appendix H. Consistent with Chowdhery et al. [2022], we sample \(k = 800\) outputs from the model and rate the outputs for toxicity using Perspective API. We manually translate the 28 English prompts into six other languages covered by Perspective API: Chinese, Portuguese, French, Dutch, German, and Swedish.
paras.zh: 我们遵循 Chowdhery 等人 [2022] 的评估协议，包括使用 PaLM 评估 [Chowdhery et al., 2022] 中列出的相同 28 个提示（见附录 H 中的表 19）。与 Chowdhery 等人 [2022] 一致，我们从模型中采样 \(k = 800\) 个输出，并使用 Perspective API 对输出进行毒性评级。我们将这 28 个英文提示手动翻译成 Perspective API 覆盖的另外六种语言：中文、葡萄牙语、法语、荷兰语、德语和瑞典语。

paras.en: Comparison across demographic subgroups. As seen in Figure 15, we observe that both Aya and Aya Safe models have lower expected maximum toxicity on average than mT0x across all languages except English. Furthermore, the Aya Safe model has a lower probability of generating toxic outputs compared to mT0x and a significantly lower probability of generating English toxic outputs than Aya.
paras.zh: 不同人口统计子组的比较：如图 15 所示，我们观察到，除英语外，Aya 和 Aya Safe 模型在所有语言上的平均预期最大毒性均低于 mT0x。此外，与 mT0x 相比，Aya Safe 模型生成有毒输出的概率更低，并且生成英语有毒输出的概率显著低于 Aya。

paras.en: Language codes: deu, eng, fra, nld, por, swe, zho; deu, eng, fra, nld, por, swe, zho. (a) Expected maximum toxicity. (b) Toxicity probability.
paras.zh: 语言代码：deu、eng、fra、nld、por、swe、zho；deu、eng、fra、nld、por、swe、zho。（a）预期最大毒性。（b）毒性概率。

paras.en: Note that because we sample a larger number of model outputs per prompt in this setup (800 as opposed to 25 in Section 7.1.1), it is substantially more likely that there is at least one output that is toxic for a given prompt (definition of toxicity probability in Section 7.1). Therefore, the toxicity probability in Figure 15b is much higher than that in Figure 14b. Our results in Appendix H.1 where we sample k = 25 outputs—identical to the setup in Section 7.1.1—show the toxicity probability distribution across languages that are more comparable to our results in Section 7.1.1.
paras.zh: 请注意，由于在此设置中我们对每个提示采样的模型输出数量更多（800 个，而第 7.1.1 节中为 25 个），因此给定提示至少有一个输出是有毒的可能性大大增加（毒性概率的定义见第 7.1 节）。因此，图 15b 中的毒性概率远高于图 14b 中的毒性概率。我们在附录 H.1 中采样 k = 25 个输出的结果（与第 7.1.1 节中的设置相同）显示，跨语言的毒性概率分布与我们在第 7.1.1 节中的结果更具可比性。

paras.en: In all languages except for English, Aya and Aya Safe models have a lower level of toxicity in generations relative to mT0x. Figure 16 breaks down the toxicity analysis across English prompts for racial identity groups and demonstrates that Aya tends to generate more toxic English outputs compared to mT0x on Asian people, White men, and Indian men, as the average and maximum toxicity scores are higher than those of mT0x. In the Appendix, we include an extended cooccurrence analysis following prior work [Brown et al., 2020; Chowdhery et al., 2022] to further understand implications of this bias. This involved counting the adjectives and adverbs in the model generation for these specific identity group prompts. We refer our readers to Appendix H.2 for our methodology and discussion of the results.
paras.zh: 除英语外，Aya 和 Aya Safe 模型在所有语言中的生成毒性水平均低于 mT0x。图 16 将毒性分析按英语提示的种族身份群体进行分解，结果表明，与 mT0x 相比，Aya 在亚洲人、白人男性和印度男性问题上倾向于生成更有毒的英语输出，因为其平均和最大毒性得分均高于 mT0x。在附录中，我们按照先前工作 [Brown et al., 2020; Chowdhery et al., 2022] 进行了扩展共现分析，以进一步理解这种偏见的影响。这涉及统计模型对这些特定身份群体提示生成内容中的形容词和副词。关于方法论和结果讨论，请参阅附录 H.2。

full.secZh: 7.2 机器翻译中的性别偏见

paras.en: In this section, we investigate to what extent the models are able to generate translations containing occupations appropriately, with the correct contexts, in gendered language.
paras.zh: 在本节中，我们探究模型在多大程度上能够在有性别的语言中根据上下文恰当地生成包含职业的翻译。

paras.en: Setup: We evaluate gender bias in translations of different languages [Ahuja et al., 2023] using the Wino-MT [Stanovsky et al., 2019] benchmark. Wino-MT is an extension of the concatenation of Winogender [Rudinger et al., 2018] and Winobias [Zhao et al., 2017], which originally targeted gender and occupational bias within English. Evaluation is performed on sentences containing occupations with pro-stereotypical as well as anti-stereotypical references to gender (male/female/neutral) when the original English sentences are translated by the models (mT0x, Aya, and Aya Safe).
paras.zh: 设置：我们使用 Wino-MT [Stanovsky et al., 2019] 基准来评估不同语言翻译中出现的性别偏见 [Ahuja et al., 2023]。Wino-MT 是 Winogender [Rudinger et al., 2018] 和 Winobias [Zhao et al., 2017] 连接后的扩展，后者最初针对英语中的性别和职业偏见。评估是在包含职业的句子上进行的，这些句子带有符合刻板印象和反刻板印象的性别指代（男性/女性/中性），当原始英语句子由模型（mT0x、Aya 和 Aya Safe）翻译时。

paras.en: Figure 33: Racial groups (Asian, Black, White, Latinx, Indian, Middle Eastern) and their male and female references, with models mT0x, Aya, and Aya Safe. The x-axis shows scores from 0.0 to 1.0. (a) Racial Groups (Man), (b) Racial Groups (Woman).
paras.zh: 图 33：种族群体（亚洲人、黑人、白人、拉丁裔、印度人、中东人）及其男性和女性指代，以及模型 mT0x、Aya 和 Aya Safe。横轴范围从 0.0 到 1.0。(a) 种族群体（男性），(b) 种族群体（女性）。

paras.en: Translations are made into Spanish, French, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Hebrew, Arabic, and German. The evaluated models are prompted with "Translate the following sentence to [target language]: [Original English sentence from Wino-MT dataset]".

paras.en: The Wino-MT benchmark provides a balanced set of sentences containing occupations and genders linked in a pro-stereotypical and anti-stereotypical manner. When the models are prompted to translate these sentences, ideally the gender related to the occupations should be maintained according to the contexts. This is measured with three metrics addressing the following questions:
paras.zh: Wino-MT 基准提供了一组平衡的句子，这些句子包含职业和性别，并以符合刻板印象和反刻板印象的方式关联。当模型被提示翻译这些句子时，理想情况下，与职业相关的性别应根据上下文得以保持。这通过三个指标来衡量，这些指标解决以下问题：

paras.en: 1. Overall accuracy measures the correctness of of gender in the translations, higher is better.— How accurately are genders translated into each language? 2. ∆S measures the accuracy difference between the pro-stereotypical and anti-stereotypical sentences that were translated by the evaluated models, lower is better.—How sensitive is the accuracy of the gender translation to stereotypes in the context? 3. ∆G measures the F1 score difference between male/female genders in the sentences translated by the evaluated models, lower is better.—How large is the gap in translation accuracy between genders?

Overall Translation Accuracy Table 9 presents the overall accuracy of the model translations for different languages. We observe a similar range of overall accuracy in Aya models and mT0x, where one is marginally better than the other in some of the languages. Aya Safe has the highest overall accuracy among the compared models for Romance languages (Spanish, French and Italian) whereas mT0x has the highest overall accuracy for Semitic languages (Hebrew and Arabic).
Accuracy and F1 difference for stereotypes and genders The comparison of these metrics on

The evaluated models are presented in Table 10. For the aspect of gender, Aya Safe has the lowest ∆G in Romance languages and German, while mT0x has the lowest ∆G in Semitic languages. A low ∆G suggests that the model is more accurately translating sentences with female gender, since generally the models have the tendency to produce generations with male gender, as illustrated in Figure 17a. On average, Aya Safe shows the most capability among the compared models in such generation. For the aspect of stereotypes, mT0x has the lowest ∆S for Spanish, Italian, Ukrainian, and German. Aya Safe has the lowest ∆S for the remaining languages, except for French, which is the same for Aya and Aya Safe. A low ∆S means that the model is capable of generating translations that are anti-stereotypical, despite the general tendency to produce pro-stereotypical translations, as shown in Figure 17b. An example of an anti-stereotypical sentence is “The nurse notified someone that his shift would be ending in an hour.” The correct choice of gender (in this case, male) in the translations for the occupational term (“nurse”) and being consistent in the context while being anti-stereotypical indicates lower bias in the generated translation by the model. In this regard, mT0x achieved the lowest average ∆S, closely followed by Aya Safe with a small margin.
paras.zh: 表 10 列出了所评估的模型。在性别方面，Aya Safe 在罗曼语族语言和德语中具有最低的 ∆G，而 mT0x 在闪米特语族语言中具有最低的 ∆G。∆G 越低表明模型能更准确地翻译带有女性性别的句子，因为通常模型倾向于生成带有男性性别的输出，如图 17a 所示。平均而言，Aya Safe 在此类生成中展现出最强的能力。在刻板印象方面，mT0x 在西班牙语、意大利语、乌克兰语和德语中具有最低的 ∆S。Aya Safe 在其余语言中具有最低的 ∆S，但法语除外，法语中 Aya 和 Aya Safe 的 ∆S 相同。∆S 越低意味着模型能够生成反刻板印象的翻译，尽管总体上存在生成亲刻板印象翻译的倾向，如图 17b 所示。反刻板印象句子的一个例子是：“护士通知某人他的班次将在一小时后结束。”在翻译职业术语（“护士”）时正确选择性别（此处为男性），并在上下文中保持一致且同时反刻板印象，这表明模型生成的翻译中偏见较低。在这方面，mT0x 实现了最低的平均 ∆S，Aya Safe 紧随其后，差距很小。

paras.en: As illustrated in Figure 17, Aya exhibits a tendency to translate sentences into male-gendered and pro-stereotypical outputs, with varying degrees across languages. All the evaluated models showed a similar trend. This is consistent with the reported observation in GPT-3 [Brown et al., 2020], where outputs with male identifiers tend to be generated.
paras.zh: 如图 17 所示，Aya 表现出将句子翻译为男性性别和亲刻板印象输出的倾向，且在不同语言中程度有所差异。所有评估的模型都显示出类似趋势。这与 GPT-3 [Brown et al., 2020] 中报告的观察结果一致，即倾向于生成带有男性标识符的输出。

paras.en: Despite producing translations that are prone to male-gendered and pro-stereotypical content, Aya and Aya Safe generate translations with an overall accuracy that is, on average, higher than mT0x. We observe promising signs from Aya Safe in terms of overall accuracy and in bridging the gender disparity gap, and thus interpret it as having less gender bias in the translation outputs.
paras.zh: 尽管生成的翻译倾向于男性性别和亲刻板印象，Aya 和 Aya Safe 生成翻译的平均整体准确率仍高于 mT0x。我们观察到 Aya Safe 在整体准确率和弥合性别差异方面展现出令人鼓舞的迹象，因此可将其解释为在翻译输出中具有较少的性别偏见。
