paras.en: Model Choice: We selected mT5 [Xue et al., 2020] as our base model. This decision was mainly driven by its vast number of languages seen during pre-training, its availability in different sizes to study scaling, and its overall strong performance. Another contender was umT5 [Chung et al., 2023a]; however, in early experiments, we did not achieve better performance using umT5. BLOOM [Scao et al., 2022] is another base model we considered; however, it has been pre-trained on fewer languages, and results in Muennighoff et al. [2023d] show that using mT5 as a base model performs better. There are many limitations with our choice of mT5: 1) Outdated knowledge: Having been pre-trained several years ago, mT5 is not as useful for interactions about events that occurred recently. 2) Performance: There are many stronger models now compared to when mT5 was released, such as the Llama series [Touvron et al., 2023a;b]. However, these are English-centric, thus not as useful as a base model for Aya. 3) Languages: We would like to go beyond the 101 included in mT5 pretraining. However, there is no model available with matching performance.
paras.zh: 模型选择：我们选择 mT5 [Xue et al., 2020] 作为基础模型。这一决定主要基于它在预训练阶段覆盖的语言数量众多、有不同规模可供研究 Scaling（规模扩张），以及整体性能强劲。另一个候选是 umT5 [Chung et al., 2023a]，但在早期实验中，我们并未在使用 umT5 时取得更好的性能。BLOOM [Scao et al., 2022] 也是我们考虑过的基础模型，但它的预训练语言数量较少，而且 Muennighoff et al. [2023d] 的结果表明使用 mT5 作为基础模型效果更好。不过，我们选择 mT5 也存在许多局限：1）知识过时：mT5 是几年前预训练的，对于涉及近期事件的交互不那么有用。2）性能：与 mT5 发布时相比，现在已有许多更强的模型，例如 Llama 系列 [Touvron et al., 2023a;b]。然而，这些模型以英语为中心，因此作为 Aya 的基础模型并不那么有用。3）语言：我们希望超越 mT5 预训练所包含的 101 种语言，但目前还没有性能相当的模型可用。

paras.en: Model Size: The Aya model is a 13 billion parameter model. In the context of massively multilingual models, a large model size was required to achieve a sensible performance across many languages, in order to mitigate capacity dilution when modeling 101 languages, commonly referred to as the curse of multilinguality [Arivazhagan et al., 2019; Conneau et al., 2019; Pfeiffer et al., 2022]. Our results in Section 5.7.1 confirm the need for a large model for multilingual instruction finetuning. However, the 13B model size limits our model usability on many consumer-grade hardware. There has been significant progress in compression techniques for large language models [Treviso et al., 2023] such as quantization [Dettmers et al., 2022; Frantar et al., 2022; Ahmadian et al., 2023] or pruning [Frantar & Alistarh, 2023; Ogueji et al., 2022; Gale et al., 2019; Ahia et al., 2021]. These techniques can be leveraged to reduce the computational cost of the Aya model for practitioners. However, we note that the trade-off between performance and computational cost still requires further research in multilingual instruction-tuned models.
paras.zh: 模型规模：Aya 模型是一个 130 亿参数的模型。在大规模多语言模型的背景下，需要在众多语言上取得合理性能，就必须使用较大的模型规模，以缓解对 101 种语言建模时的容量稀释问题，即通常所说的多语言诅咒 [Arivazhagan et al., 2019; Conneau et al., 2019; Pfeiffer et al., 2022]。我们在 5.7.1 节的结果证实了多语言指令微调需要大模型。然而，13B 的模型规模限制了模型在许多消费级硬件上的可用性。大语言模型的压缩技术已经取得了显著进展 [Treviso et al., 2023]，例如量化 [Dettmers et al., 2022; Frantar et al., 2022; Ahmadian et al., 2023] 或剪枝 [Frantar & Alistarh, 2023; Ogueji et al., 2022; Gale et al., 2019; Ahia et al., 2021]。这些技术可用来降低 Aya 模型对从业者的计算成本。但我们注意到，在多语言指令微调模型中，性能与计算成本之间的权衡仍需进一步研究。

paras.en: Language and dialect coverage: The Aya model covers 101 languages and improves performance relative to the closest open-source model. However, this is still only a tiny fraction of the world’s linguistic diversity. Of the world’s approximately 7,000 languages, only half of them are captured in any sort of written form [Adda et al., 2016]. Of this half, only a few hundred are included on the internet in machine-readable corpora [Adda et al., 2016]. This means that 93% of the world’s languages are still not being used to train LLMs. It is also notoriously difficult to determine the dividing line between different languages and different dialects of the same language [Rooy, 2021]. Geo-cultural variation within a language often gives rise to dialects [Zampieri et al., 2020; Wolfram, 1997; Brown et al., 2020; Lent et al., 2022; Blaschke et al., 2023] and can serve as an important part of cultural identity [Falck et al., 2012]. Many different dialects that are generally recognized as belonging to a single parent language are not represented in this model’s training data. Lastly, sociolinguistic data show that multilingual speakers often ‘code-switch’ between languages or dialects depending on context [Myers-Scotton, 2017], but in this project, languages are treated as isolated to make them easier to classify and to be used downstream for language-specific applications.
paras.zh: 语言与方言覆盖：Aya 模型覆盖 101 种语言，相比最接近的开源模型提升了性能。然而，这仍只是世界语言多样性的极小一部分。世界上约有 7000 种语言，其中只有一半有任何形式的书面记录 [Adda et al., 2016]。在这一半中，只有几百种被纳入互联网上可机读的语料库 [Adda et al., 2016]。这意味着全球 93% 的语言仍未被用于训练大语言模型。此外，区分不同语言与同一语言的不同方言之间的界限也是出了名的困难 [Rooy, 2021]。语言内部的地理文化差异常常催生方言 [Zampieri et al., 2020; Wolfram, 1997; Brown et al., 2020; Lent et al., 2022; Blaschke et al., 2023]，并可能成为文化认同的重要组成部分 [Falck et al., 2012]。许多通常被认为属于同一个母语的不同方言并未出现在该模型的训练数据中。最后，社会语言学数据表明，多语使用者常常会根据语境在语言或方言之间进行“语码转换” [Myers-Scotton, 2017]，但在本项目里，语言被当成彼此独立的系统来处理，以便于分类并用于下游的特定语言应用。

paras.en: Model values: Another potential risk is the presence of particular cultural biases in model behavior. The translated datasets in the Aya training overindex on datasets created in the Global North or Western regions. This could introduce a skew towards a narrow selection of cultural viewpoints. Even our human-annotated Aya dataset often presented annotator skew, with a majority of annotators for a language from a single region despite that language being spoken in many different regions. For example, contributions in French might contain a lot of content about the history of France, its food, songs, and other cultural practices, but not contain much information about the cultural heritage of French-speaking communities in Québec, Togo, or Senegal [Vigouroux, 2013]. For the Aya collection of templated datasets used to train this model, there is a potential bias in the availability of particular kinds of content. For example, it is easier to find text from news sites for many African languages than it is to find text from other domains. Some datasets will be skewed towards the language used in news reports instead of the kind of natural language people use in everyday life [Hovy & Prabhumoye, 2021].
paras.zh: 模型价值观：另一个潜在风险是模型行为中可能存在特定的文化偏见。Aya 训练中使用的翻译数据集过度集中于全球北方或西方地区创建的数据集，这可能会导致模型偏向于狭窄的文化视角。即使是我们的人工标注 Aya 数据集也常常存在标注者偏差：某种语言虽有多个地区的使用者，但大多数标注者却来自同一地区。例如，法语贡献内容可能包含大量关于法国历史、食物、歌曲及其他文化习俗的内容，但关于魁北克、多哥或塞内加尔法语区社区文化遗产的内容却不多 [Vigouroux, 2013]。在用于训练该模型的 Aya 模板化数据集集合中，特定类型内容的可得性也可能存在偏差。例如，对许多非洲语言来说，从新闻网站获取文本比从其他领域获取文本更容易。一些数据集会偏向新闻报道所用的语言，而非人们在日常生活中使用的自然语言 [Hovy & Prabhumoye, 2021]。

paras.en: Model behavior: Some of the languages in the Aya model only contain pronouns that are explicitly gendered (e.g., Arabic), or lack a third-person plural pronoun (e.g., English: they/them/their). This means that in responding to prompts that might not specify a gender, care needs to be taken to
paras.zh: 模型行为：Aya 模型中的某些语言只含有明确区分性别的代词（如阿拉伯语），或者缺少第三人称复数代词（如英语的 they/them/their）。这意味着在回应可能未指定性别的提示词时，需要注意

paras.en: ensure that responses remain neutral as to the gender of any assumed participants. For example, if a response requires reference to “a teacher” in French, the annotator would need to include references to both “un/e enseignant/e”. Furthermore, language often requires the speaker or annotator to make situational choices as to the formality of the pronoun used in response to a particular prompt. Languages such as Japanese, Indonesian, Javanese, Yoruba, French, Spanish, and German include different levels of honorifics that are used in formal or informal settings, or used between community members who differ in status (determined either by age or by profession) [Brown & Gilman, 1968]. In Yoruba, for example, the pronoun that roughly translates as “they” can either be used as a singular honorific or as a third-person plural pronoun [Yusuf, 2022]. Given that we sample from many different data sources, and also rely on translated data which may present differences in quality across languages—it is very possible our model does not demonstrate these types of nuances expected from language speakers and may present varying levels of standardization and differing formality specification.
paras.zh: 确保回复对任何假定参与者的性别保持中立。例如，如果某个回复需要用法语提及“一位教师”，标注者就需要同时包括“un/e enseignant/e”这一兼顾两性的表达。此外，语言常常要求说话者或标注者根据具体提示，对所用代词做出场合选择，如正式或非正式用法。日语、印尼语、爪哇语、约鲁巴语、法语、西班牙语和德语等语言包含不同等级的敬语，用于正式或非正式场合，或用于地位不同（由年龄或职业决定）的社区成员之间 [Brown & Gilman, 1968]。以约鲁巴语为例，大致可译为“他们”的代词既可以用作单数敬称，也可以用作第三人称复数代词 [Yusuf, 2022]。鉴于我们从许多不同的数据源进行采样，并且还依赖在不同语言间可能存在质量差异的翻译数据——我们的模型很可能无法展现语言使用者所期望的这类细微差别，并可能呈现出不同的标准化程度和正式性规范。

paras.en: Language representation is a consequence of the choices made and resources spent by the development community. The Aya Initiative chooses to tackle the widening gap both in who creates, and who is represented by modern language models. Assembling over 3000 collaborators, representing 110 countries, and 101 languages, we more than double the languages covered in instruction fine-tuning, evaluation, and safety. We source and release all these resources under fully permissive, open-source compliant licenses, to further our mission of multilingual technologies empowering a multilingual world.
paras.zh: 语言表征是开发社区所做出的选择和所投入资源的产物。Aya 倡议致力于解决日益扩大的差距，既包括由谁来创建现代语言模型，也包括谁被这些模型所代表。我们汇聚了来自 110 个国家和 101 种语言的 3000 多名合作者，将指令微调、评估和安全方面所覆盖的语言数量增加了一倍以上。我们在完全许可、符合开源标准的许可协议下获取并发布所有这些资源，以进一步实现我们通过多语言技术赋权多语言世界的使命。

paras.en: The Aya Model vastly improves over all massively multilingual, open-source models, across a battery of automatic and human evaluation settings. We expand the axes of evaluation to shed light on multilingual capabilities, both for Aya, and for future development projects. We transparently characterize model biases, toxicity, and harm across languages to raise the bar of multilingual safety evaluations.
